column1: # Alex stops the party in Mogall Forest and unsettles Mia.

column3: Slow down, Isaac. This\nforest eats the careless.{end_wait}
Alex. Why do you keep\nturning up ahead of us?{end_wait}
Because I know where this\nroad ends. Ask the blade's\ndaughter. She knows too.{end_wait}
You speak too freely,\nsmuggler. Know your place.{end_wait}
There it is. The voice\nthat is not hers. Old, and\nvery hungry.{end_wait}
Isaac, what is he on about?\nWhat voice?{end_wait}
Ask her. I will wait in\nthe mountains. Hurry.{end_wait}
